Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner asserted that the Svensk Filmdatabas (SFdb) page stated Gustaf Molander was born in Helsingborg, Sweden, treating a search-result snippet as confirmed evidence without opening and verifying the source. This misinterpretation (likely confusing Helsingborg with Helsingfors/Helsinki) contradicted authoritative sources and the SFdb page itself when viewed later, leading toward the wrong birthplace conclusion.
